messages.text: Moved from Define to Build: confirmed sensible defaults (local pass-and-play on one device, CSS 3D transforms for true single-file offline use, no AI/sound/themes in v1) and recorded the "build-it" instruction; the code file gets written next run.

To play: save or locate **tictactoe.html** on the device, then double-tap/double-click it (or drag it into a browser tab). It runs entirely offline — no server, install, or account needed. Two players share the screen and take turns tapping cells.

If you want an actual shareable link so others can play from their own devices, you'd need to host the file yourself — upload it to any static web host or your own website, then share that address. I can't generate or provide URLs, but the file is ready to be hosted anywhere as-is.
— BUILD | open: verify game in-browser, optional polish (winning-line highlight, new-round button) | next: playtest tictactoe.html and report issues
